title: Logit-lens vs SAE for ELK: a cheap apples-to-apples comparison

original_idea.body: Logit-lens vs pre-trained SAE for ELK on the released Taboo model (arXiv:2505.14352). Head-to-head recovery accuracy and compute cost under a consumer-GPU budget.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain to ELK tooling but it is a methods comparison; impact is real yet a step removed from a catastrophic scenario.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reuses released Taboo model + pre-trained SAE, inference-only; a motivated beginner can make progress.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single head-to-head comparison with a clear recovery-accuracy success metric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: ELK-relevant, open models/data, weak lab incentive; a budget-aware recipe is independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference + pre-trained SAE only; explicitly consumer-GPU budgeted.

novelty.reasoning: Both methods used in the source paper; a clean budget-aware comparison may be a partly-open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Methods already used together; the cost-comparison angle may be open.
